requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
PHYSICAL THERAPY — INITIAL EVALUATION — 05/03/2025
Dx: mechanical low back pain, 6 weeks, after moving apartments. No radicular symptoms, neuro intact.
Findings: reduced lumbar flexion, weak core/glute activation, pain 4/10.
Plan of care: 6 visits over 6 weeks; core stabilization home exercise program (dead bug, bird dog, glute bridge, side plank progressions) daily; posture/lifting education; heat PRN.
Goals: pain ≤1/10, return to full activity.

A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 26.8 — plan today:
 - Calorie tracking, ~1800 kcal/day; cut late-night snacking and takeout.
 - Water aerobics / lap swimming 3 times a week.
 - Enrolled in the health system's 12-month lifestyle modification program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on rosuvastatin 10 mg daily; last LDL 186. Family history noted; continue statin, recheck lipids.
3. Anxiety — stable.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 01/04/2026
Lifestyle program intake. Food log: coffee only until noon, takeout dinner at 9 PM most nights, snacking after.
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1800 kcal/day; breakfast daily; meal-prep dinners on Sundays; no eating after 9:30 PM; heart-healthy fats, more soluble fiber (oats, beans) given LDL.
Activity: swimming / water aerobics 3x/week.
RD follow-up in 6 weeks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/28/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1800 kcal; takeout down to once a week.
Adjustments: smaller portions of pasta, add a vegetable at lunch; plan for summer barbecues.
Reports she keeps up with swimming 3x/week.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/20/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program visits since December — tracking, meal prep, swimming. Frustrated: weight 71.5 kg today vs 71.3 kg when she started (+0.3%), no change despite reported adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Uses IUD.
O: Wt 71.5 kg, BMI 26.9. BP 118/69.
